env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# Rows O-A13 and O-A14: a tool directive resolves and runs in a loGo/s
# module, and a generator-produced plain .go inside a .lgo package fails
# the load with correctness::mixed_package. The generate step below
# really runs: if it produced nothing, the `! logos list` line would fail.
cd toolmod
logos build ./...
logos tool strgen hello
stdout 'strgen:hello'
! logos tool nosuchtool
cd ..

cd genmod
logos build ./...
mkdir -p $WORK/genbin
logos build -o $WORK/genbin/strgen$GOEXE ./tool/strgen
env PATH=$WORK/genbin${:}$PATH
logos generate ./...
! logos list ./...
stderr 'correctness::mixed_package'
stderr 'gen_string\.go'
stderr 'p\.lgo'
! logos build ./...
stderr 'correctness::mixed_package'
cd ..

# A generator MAY write .go files into a Go package that a
# loGo/s package imports: the generated file joins a
# pure-Go package, the .lgo importer builds, and the
# generated symbol runs.
cd gogenmod
mkdir -p $WORK/gogenbin
logos build -o $WORK/gogenbin/strgen$GOEXE ./tool/strgen
env PATH=$WORK/gogenbin${:}$PATH
cd ../q
logos generate ./...
cd ../gogenmod
logos build ./...
logos run ./cmd
stdout '^base-gen$'
cd ..

-- toolmod/go.mod --
module example.com/w5tool

go 1.27

tool example.com/w5tool/tool/strgen

-- toolmod/p/p.lgo --
package p

func Hello() string { return "hi" }

-- toolmod/tool/strgen/strgen.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
)

func main() { fmt.Println("strgen:" + os.Args[1]) }

-- genmod/go.mod --
module example.com/w5gen

go 1.27

-- genmod/p/p.lgo --
package p

//go:generate strgen -out gen_string.go

func FromLGO() string { return "lgo" }

-- genmod/tool/strgen/strgen.lgo --
package main

import (
	"flag"
	"os"
)

func main() {
	out := flag.String("out", "", "")
	flag.Parse()
	if err := os.WriteFile(*out, []byte("// Code generated by strgen. DO NOT EDIT.\n\npackage p\n\nfunc FromGen() string { return \"gen\" }\n"), 0644); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}

-- gogenmod/go.mod --
module example.com/w5gogen

go 1.27

require example.com/w5gogen/q v0.0.0

replace example.com/w5gogen/q => ../q

-- q/go.mod --
module example.com/w5gogen/q

go 1.27

-- q/q.go --
package q

//go:generate strgen -out gen_string.go

func Base() string { return "base" }

-- gogenmod/cmd/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/w5gogen/q"
)

func main() { fmt.Println(q.Base() + "-" + q.Gen()) }

-- gogenmod/tool/strgen/strgen.lgo --
package main

import (
	"flag"
	"os"
)

func main() {
	out := flag.String("out", "", "")
	flag.Parse()
	if err := os.WriteFile(*out, []byte("// Code generated by strgen. DO NOT EDIT.\n\npackage q\n\nfunc Gen() string { return \"gen\" }\n"), 0644); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}
